title: Fantastic Montserrat experience
text: Absolutely fun and informative experience led by our tour guide Vicente and our driver Joaquin. Because of them, we had a grand time exploring Montserrat in its full beauty.
author: Explorer47904101095

title: The best way to get to Montserrat.
text: Vincent was very efficient with the hotel pickup and gave us a lot of interesting information. Joachim drove with great competence on the twisty mountain roads. This was an excellent way to see Montserrat and the surrounding countryside. We highly recommend the easy walk to the cross you can see from the monastery. The views from there to the Pyrannees in the north to the Mediterranean in the south were stunning. We highly recommend this tour.
